culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Bhopal office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year.

As of 8 November 2026, the state permit portal says the Bastua zone of Sanjay-Dubri Tiger Reserve is closed for booking from 19 October 2026 until further notice, with advance permits cancelled and refunds handled by the park authority. Check whether the alert has been lifted before planning that zone.

The state forest portal provides permit booking for named tiger reserves, including Kanha, Bandhavgarh, Panna, Pench, Satpura, Sanjay-Dubri, Ratapani, Madhav and Veerangana Durgavati. Select the exact park, zone, date and safari before relying on availability or permit terms.

The state forest portal publishes revised safari entry and exit times effective for safari dates from 1 October 2026, with different morning and afternoon windows by season. Times and access can change; check the specific park, date and current notice before booking.
